entities.name: Aminatou
entities.description: A young human fateshifter wizard and former planeswalker who lost her spark in the Desparkening; she manipulates fate with moths.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who led the retrieval of Nashi from Duskmourn.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane Nashi was rescued from.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where Aminatou assisted the team.

entities.name: Proft
entities.description: Created an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Entity holding the rescued people in Duskmourn.

entities.name: Yoshimaru
entities.description: Watched Nashi tell their story on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Where Nashi told of their adventures.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event in which Aminatou lost her spark.

entities.name: Isona Maive
entities.description: Planeswalker Aminatou meets in the non-canon comic.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Incinerated one of Aminatou's moths in the comic.

events.summary: Aminatou's spark ignites at a young age because she foresaw it and chose not to wait.
events.quote: Her spark ignited at a young age

events.summary: Aminatou loses her spark during the Desparkening.
events.quote: Aminatou lost her spark during the Desparkening.

events.summary: Aminatou travels to Ravnica around 4564 AR to assist the team recovering Nashi from Duskmourn.
events.quote: Aminatou traveled to Ravnica around 4564 AR

events.summary: Kaito returns alone in a panic; Niv-Mizzet questions him and Aminatou reassures him his spark is intact.
events.quote: Aminatou reassured Kaito that his spark was still intact

events.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath using Kaito's spark and Aminatou's abilities, and Kaito and Proft rescue Nashi and the others from Valgavoth.
events.quote: Proft successfully created an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn

events.summary: On Kamigawa, Nashi tells of their adventures to children including Aminatou.
events.quote: Nashi told of their adventures to an enthralled group of children

relations.note: Explains her powers to Isona in the comic.
relations.quote: Aminatou tells Isona Maive that her powers do not let her alter an individual's choices
